title: Ethical Reporting of AI Use
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting ethical reporting of ai use to AI-USE disclosure excerpt tied to one bounded design-support decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish a vague disclosure ("AI was used") from a bounded one that names the decision, the AI contribution, and the verification
Reject accountability-shedding language (the output is "objective" because AI made it) and keep responsibility with the human
Document accept/reject calls on AI suggestions, with the reason for each
Decide the right granularity of disclosure: enough for a reviewer to judge provenance, not a full transcript

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
